themes: Signs in the sky and earth
summary_for_children: Al-Hijr says Allah protects the Quran, shows the stars, mountains and winds as signs, and tells of the people of al-Hijr who carved homes in the mountains.
environment_concept: A rocky tract under the stars: constellations (15:16), firm mountains (15:19), winds carrying pollen to flowers (15:22) and empty homes carved in the cliffs (15:82).
architecture_and_scenery: Sandstone cliffs with carved facades, high mountains, a starry sky, and green slopes.

palette.lighting: Warm rock in sun, deep blue night

areas.name: Sky of Constellations
areas.description: A night sky with bright constellations.

areas.name: Fertilizing Winds
areas.description: Winds that carry pollen to plants.

areas.name: Carved Homes
areas.description: Homes carved in the cliffs, empty.

activities.name: Carry the pollen
activities.description: Carry pollen to three bare beds; they flower.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Find the constellations
activities.description: Find five bright stars low over the rocks.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator explains the peoples' story as explanation and reads 15:9 at the start.
learning_objectives: Learn about the people of al-Hijr

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (carved, constellation, mountain, wind) with 2 hands-on activities in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
